snippet.title: The FIFA World Cup 2026™ Takes Over Rocket League® Season 23!
snippet.description:
Season 23 launches on June 10th, featuring the FIFA World Cup 2026 LTE, new gameplay updates including Demo Spawn Control, and the HYUNDAI IONIQ 6 N Line vehicle!

Full blog: https://rl.gg/rlseason23
